message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint in Atlanta through several official channels. Below is an overview of what’s required, who handles the request, and how to submit your complaint: | Step | What You Need | Where / How | |------|---------------|-------------| | **Identify the source** | • Residential area
• Commercial property
• Public space | Helps determine which agency will handle it | | **Check the ordinance** | *Atlanta Municipal Code § 10‑1‑2* – “Noise” definition & limits (e.g., daytime ≤70 dB, nighttime ≤60 dB) | Provides legal basis for enforcement | | **Choose a filing method** | • Online portal
• Phone (non‑emergency)
• In person | Pick whichever suits you best | --- ### 1️⃣ Online Filing **Website:** [https://www.atlantaga.gov](https://www.atlantaga.gov) 1. Go to the site and click **“Contact Us.”** 2. Select **“Non‑Emergency Services → Noise Complaint.”** 3. Fill out the web form—include address, description, time(s), and any evidence (photos, audio clips). 4. Submit. A confirmation email will appear with a reference number. *(Tip:* If you’re unsure whether the issue falls under residential or commercial noise rules, choose “Other” and let staff clarify.) --- ### 2️⃣ Phone Submission - **Police Non‑Emergency Line:** 404‑656‑4000 (press “9”) - Tell them you’d like to file a noise complaint. - They’ll log it into the system and may dispatch officers if necessary. - **Department of Public Works (DPW):** 404‑656‑4100 - Handles construction‑related noise and street‑level disturbances. Both lines operate Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; after hours, leave a voicemail and expect a callback during business days. --- ### 3️⃣ In‑Person Visit If you prefer face‑to‑face interaction: - **City Hall – Office of the Mayor** (120 Peachtree St NE, Suite 200) - **DPW Headquarters** (300 West Ponce de Leon Ave NW) Bring written documentation (address, dates/times, photos/audio). --- ### 4️⃣ Additional Tips | Tip | Why It Matters | |-----|----------------| | **Document everything** | Photos, videos, timestamps help prove violation. | | **Know the quiet hours** | Residential areas typically have stricter limits from 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. | | **Follow up** | Use the reference number to check status via the online portal or by phone. | | **Escalate if ignored** | After 48 hrs without action, ask for a supervisor or consider filing a formal petition with the City Council. | --- #### Quick Reference Links - **Noise Ordinance Text** – Atlanta Municipal Code § 10‑1‑2: [Link](https://library.atlantagov.org/mc/codes/municipal-code/chapter-10-noise/) - **Online Form** – Direct link: [Submit Noise Complaint](https://atlantaga.gov/services/noise-complaints) *(if available)* - **City Council Contact** – For persistent issues: [Council Member Directory](https://atlantaga.gov/government/council-members) Feel free to reach out again if you need step‑by‑step assistance filling out the form or interpreting specific parts of the ordinance!
